blockers.message: the review record has no `## code.review` section, while roles were active at it
R-accessibility-1 (Field errors are conveyed by colour only) is high and still open; fix it, or a human accepts the risk or defers it

findings.evidence:
`field--invalid`, a red border (`#e5484d`); the list of errors at the top of
the page is removed, since the red border already shows where the problem
is. No message text is added, to keep the form compact.
findings.recommendation: Fails WCAG 1.4.1 Use of Color, 3.3.1 Error Identification and 1.3.1 Info and Relationships. A screen reader user who leaves the postcode field with `ABC` hears nothing: the field is not marked `aria-invalid` and no text says what is wrong; a colour-blind or low-vision user cannot tell the red border from the grey one, and nobody learns what the rule is (the current text messages from `rules.ts` are dropped). Render the rule's message as text under each invalid field, associate it with `aria-describedby`, set `aria-invalid="true"` on the input, and rewrite the spec scenarios "An invalid postcode" and "A corrected field" (which only check the border colour) to require the message and its association; the spec's Purpose already promises "errors next to the fields".
findings.title: Field errors are conveyed by colour only

findings.evidence: - The error list at the top of the form is removed.
findings.recommendation: Today `Form.tsx` renders the summary in a `role="alert"` region, so a failed submit is announced. With it removed and validation only on `blur`, a keyboard or screen reader user who presses Pay with an untouched or invalid field hears nothing and focus stays on the button: the submit silently does nothing (WCAG 3.3.1 Error Identification, 4.1.3 Status Messages). On a failed submit, either keep a summary in a live region linking to the fields, or move focus to the first invalid field whose message is associated by `aria-describedby`; add a scenario for submitting with invalid fields.
findings.title: Removing the error summary leaves a failed submit unannounced
